# Lakeside Late Payment Rules

TEST FIXTURE ONLY. Synthetic text written for software evaluation; it is not part of any real corpus.

## 1 Reminders

A payment reminder costs 5 euros.

## 2 Restriction

After 60 days of non-payment the water supply is restricted to a minimum flow; it is never cut off completely.

## 3 Payment plans

Customers can request a payment plan of up to 12 months at the UCC.
